2115539246878732309.en_summary: $MSFT Microsoft Quarterly Profit Soars as Cloud Growth Accelerates — WSJ. The 48% growth in the Azure cloud business propelled Microsoft's revenue to $92.28 billion, up 19%, for its fiscal first quarter. The result handily beat Wall Street's expectations for $90.62 billion in revenue. The new Agent and Infra segment contributed $76.8 billion in revenue. Microsoft logged a profit of $36.63 billion, or $4.92 a share, up from $27.75 billion a year earlier. On an adjusted basis, earnings were $4.89 a share, ahead of the $4.71 expected.

ticker_notes.MSFT: Azure +48%, rev $92.28B beat, profit $36.63B or $4.92 EPS
